:::Should shadow spawn be here?  The rest seem to be essentially social groups, whereas the various shadowspawn seem to be actual distinct species. --[[User:Marudubshinki|Maru]]  [[User talk:Marudubshinki|(talk)]] [[Special:Contributions/Marudubshinki|Contribs]] 02:28, 5 Nov 2005 (UTC)

:::: Oh, and what about Ogier, Aelfinn, Eelfinn, and Wolves?  Are you going to classify ''them'' as ''Homo sapiens'' ?  Due to the anthropomorphic nature of fantasy, our use of "races" encapsulates "species". --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 03:35, 5 Nov 2005 (UTC)

:::::Really, what I am objecting to is that we have all sorts of ''human'' social categorizations on the same level of the hierarchy as bona fide species/races- like the *finn, the wolves, and so on.  Are Aiel really as distinct and separable from, say, Illians as they are from Wolves?  I don't think so. We need a human category we can stick all the Aiel, Andoran, Borderlands..... &etc --[[User:Marudubshinki|Maru]]  [[User talk:Marudubshinki|(talk)]] [[Special:Contributions/Marudubshinki|Contribs]] 00:34, 6 Nov 2005 (UTC)

:::::: If you can come up with a good name for such a category, and a way to relate it to "Races and Nationalities", then we could use it.  But they are apparently sentient beings, so I personally don't see any point to this "non-human" distinction you are making.  --[[User:146.151.57.255|146.151.57.255]] 00:44, 6 Nov 2005 (UTC)

:::::::How's that? --[[User:Marudubshinki|Maru]]  [[User talk:Marudubshinki|(talk)]] [[Special:Contributions/Marudubshinki|Contribs]] 01:01, 6 Nov 2005 (UTC)

:::::::: I like it (either with the subcat "Humans" or not), but it does raise the question of whether the supercat "People" is really appropriate. "Entities" is so clinical; "Beings"? [[User:Nae'blis|nae'blis]] <i><sub>[[User_talk:Nae'blis|(talk)]]</sub></i> 04:05, 7 Nov 2005 (UTC)

::::::::: There are several definitions of person/people.  I of course am of the opinion that in the context of most Fantasy and Sci-fi, being human is not a necessary condition.  But we could go back to the original "Characters" supercat... --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 04:49, 7 Nov 2005 (UTC)

:::::::::: Oh, I agree with you, they're all "People", just wasn't sure if that was just me. I'd prefer that to "Characters", in line with my immersive ''[[wikipedia:modus operandi|modus operandi]]''. See above. [[User:Nae'blis|nae'blis]] <i><sub>[[User_talk:Nae'blis|(talk)]]</sub></i> 22:10, 7 Nov 2005 (UTC)

::::::::::: I'd rather go back to [[:Category:People]] anyway, so I'm gonna switchover the ones that are in Characters. I think I was the only one seriously bringing up the question... [[User:Nae'blis|nae'blis]] ''<sub>[[User_talk:Nae'blis|(talk)]]</sub>'' 18:31, 23 Dec 2005 (UTC)

:::: And now for a more apropos argument, how many times have you heard someone in real life refer to "<span class=plainlinks>[http://www.googlefight.com/index.php?lang=en_GB&word1=%22the+human+race%22&word2=%22the+human+species%22 the human race]</span>" ?  I rest my case. --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 12:07, 7 Nov 2005 (UTC)
